instruction: Configure VLC to open every file in a new window rather than reusing the same instance.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling VLC's single instance mode when files are opened by setting one-instance-when-started-from-file=0 (default is 1). The evaluator uses the existing check_one_instance_when_started_from_file metric function to verify the setting is disabled. The get_vlc_config getter reads the VLC config file (~/.config/vlc/vlcrc) and the metric checks if the setting is 0. No new functions needed - reusing existing VLC evaluation infrastructure.
metadata.similarity_to_original: Very similar - both tasks involve changing a single VLC preference setting. Original disables splash cone icon, this disables single instance mode.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_vlc_config reads the VLC configuration file from the correct platform-specific path (~/.config/vlc/vlcrc on Linux)

Expected value is semantically correct: expected value of 0 correctly represents disabling single instance mode, matching the instruction requirement
Complete coverage: The evaluator checks the exact setting that controls the feature described in the instruction (disable single instance mode when files are opened)
Correct parameter handling: Metric function correctly accesses the expected parameter as rule['expected_one_instance_when_started_from_file'] without incorrect 'rules' nesting
Appropriate postconfig: Kills and relaunches VLC to ensure config file is read in a clean state
